messages.summary:
## Objective
- Buat menu utama dan game sederhana untuk **The Goddes and The Conquest**.
- Tambahkan halaman pemilihan scenario setelah memilih **New Game**, dengan scenario **The Beginning**.

## Requirements
- Menu utama hanya menampilkan judul dan **New Game**, **Load Game**, **Option**, **Created Character** terkunci, dan **Exit**.
- Pada halaman scenario, tampilkan **The Beginning**; biografi, gambar karakter, dan peta dihilangkan dulu; layout disamakan dengan gaya yang sudah ada.

## Decisions
- Implementasi dibuat sebagai game browser satu halaman di `index.html`.
- Halaman scenario memakai panel dekoratif kosong agar biografi, gambar, dan peta tidak ditampilkan.

## Work State
### Completed
- Menu utama dan game strategi sederhana sudah dibuat, termasuk penaklukan wilayah, opsi, save/load, dan tombol keluar.
- Browser memverifikasi menu, penaklukan wilayah, serta penyimpanan dan pemuatan progres.
- Markup dan styling awal halaman scenario sudah ditambahkan.

### Active
- Hubungkan tombol **New Game** agar membuka halaman scenario.
- Tambahkan perilaku pilih **The Beginning**, tombol **Begin**, dan tombol kembali; setelah memilih **Begin**, mulai game.

### Blocked
- Belum ada yang memblokir; perubahan halaman scenario belum lengkap dan belum diuji.

## Next Move
1. Lengkapi pergantian layar dengan memasukkan halaman scenario ke mekanisme `showScreen`.
2. Ubah handler `newGame` untuk membuka scenario, lalu implementasikan pilih **The Beginning**, mulai game, dan kembali ke menu.
3. Verifikasi alur scenario dan game di browser.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: implementasi menu, gameplay, serta markup dan styling scenario yang sedang dikerjakan.

## Important Context
- Perubahan belum di-commit.
- Handler `newGame` saat ini masih langsung memulai game; markup halaman scenario belum terhubung ke JavaScript.

                <h3>Lux Osborn</h3>
                <p>Lux Osborn is the young king of the Imperial Kingdom, inheriting the throne from his father.</p>
                <p>From an early age, Lux was raised under an exceptionally strict education. His father believed that a future ruler must prove his capabilities rather than rely solely on royal blood.</p>
                <p>To determine which of his children was most worthy of succession, his father arranged numerous competitions between Lux and his brothers and sisters.</p>
                <p>These contests tested their abilities, discipline, intelligence, and determination.</p>
                <p>Lux emerged victorious in every competition, ultimately proving himself as the strongest candidate for the throne.</p>
                <p>His upbringing shaped him into a strict and disciplined ruler who demands excellence from himself and those under his command.</p>
                <p>As king, Lux maintains an uncompromising approach to law and order. He believes that authority must be respected and that responsibility comes before privilege.</p>
                <p>Although his methods are often considered severe, Lux does not rule through cruelty. He simply refuses to accept incompetence from those entrusted with great responsibility.</p>
                <p>To him, the throne is not a privilege inherited by birth, but a responsibility that must be earned.</p>
              </div>

            </div>

<script>
(() => {
  const menu = document.getElementById('menu');
  const scenario = document.getElementById('scenario');
  const game = document.getElementById('game');
  const exitScreen = document.getElementById('exitScreen');
  const saveKey = 'goddes-conquest-save-v1';
  const realms = [
    {name:'Crown',description:'The heartland answers to your banner.'},
    {name:'Ashen Veil',description:'A border keep stands between you and the northern road.'},
    {name:'Ravenhold',description:'A fortified pass guards the old kingdom.'},
    {name:'Mistwood',description:'A quiet forest hides a stubborn garrison.'},
    {name:'Frostfall',description:'The mountain stronghold watches from the far ridge.'}
  ];
  let state = null;
  let selected = null;
  let toastTimer;
  const buttons = [...document.querySelectorAll('.territory')];
  function freshGame(){return {day:1,essence:5,owned:[0],enemyPower:0};}
  function showScreen(which){[menu,scenario,game,exitScreen].forEach(screen=>screen.classList.toggle('active',screen===which));}
  function updateLoad(){document.getElementById('loadGame').disabled=!localStorage.getItem(saveKey);}
  function save(){if(state)localStorage.setItem(saveKey,JSON.stringify(state));updateLoad();}
  function start(next){state=next;selected=null;showScreen(game);render();}
  function render(){
    if(!state)return;
    document.getElementById('dayStat').textContent=state.day;
    document.getElementById('essenceStat').textContent=state.essence;
    document.getElementById('realmStat').textContent=`${state.owned.length} / ${realms.length}`;
    buttons.forEach((element,index)=>{
      const owned=state.owned.includes(index);
      element.classList.toggle('owned',owned);
      element.classList.toggle('enemy',!owned&&index<3);
      element.classList.toggle('locked',!owned&&index>=3);
      element.classList.toggle('selected',selected===index);
    });
    const details=selected===null?realms[state.owned[0]]:realms[selected];
    document.getElementById('realmName').textContent=details.name;
    document.getElementById('realmDescription').textContent=selected===null?'Select a neighboring realm to march.':state.owned.includes(selected)?'This realm flies beneath your banner.':`Conquer this realm and bring it beneath your banner.`;
    const canMarch=selected!==null&&!state.owned.includes(selected)&&state.owned.some(id=>Math.abs(id-selected)===1)&&state.essence>=2;
    document.getElementById('march').disabled=!canMarch;
  }
  function notify(message){const toast=document.getElementById('toast');toast.textContent=message;toast.hidden=false;clearTimeout(toastTimer);toastTimer=setTimeout(()=>toast.hidden=true,1700);}
  const beginningScenario=document.getElementById('beginningScenario');
  const startScenario=document.getElementById('startScenario');
  document.getElementById('newGame').addEventListener('click',()=>{
    beginningScenario.classList.remove('selected');
    beginningScenario.setAttribute('aria-pressed','false');
    document.getElementById('characterPanel').hidden=true;
    startScenario.disabled=true;
    document.querySelector('.scenario-hint').textContent='Select a scenario to choose your character.';
    showScreen(scenario);
  });
  beginningScenario.addEventListener('click',()=>{
    beginningScenario.classList.add('selected');
    beginningScenario.setAttribute('aria-pressed','true');
    document.getElementById('characterPanel').hidden=false;
    startScenario.disabled=false;
    document.querySelector('.scenario-hint').textContent='Character selected: Lux Osborn.';
  });
  startScenario.addEventListener('click',()=>{if(!startScenario.disabled)start(freshGame());});
  document.getElementById('scenarioBack').addEventListener('click',()=>showScreen(menu));
  document.getElementById('loadGame').addEventListener('click',()=>{try{const data=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(saveKey));if(data&&Array.isArray(data.owned))start(data);}catch{localStorage.removeItem(saveKey);updateLoad();}});
  document.getElementById('options').addEventListener('click',()=>{document.getElementById('optionsModal').hidden=false;});
  document.getElementById('closeOptions').addEventListener('click',()=>{document.getElementById('optionsModal').hidden=true;});
  document.getElementById('optionsModal').addEventListener('click',event=>{if(event.target.id==='optionsModal')event.currentTarget.hidden=true;});
  document.getElementById('motion').addEventListener('change',event=>{document.querySelector('.scene svg').style.animation=event.target.checked?'drift 40s ease-in-out infinite alternate':'none';});
  buttons.forEach(element=>element.addEventListener('click',()=>{const id=Number(element.dataset.id);if(state.owned.includes(id))selected=null;else selected=id;render();}));
  document.getElementById('march').addEventListener('click',()=>{
    const march=document.getElementById('march');if(march.disabled)return;
    state.essence-=2;state.owned.push(selected);state.owned.sort((a,b)=>a-b);selected=null;render();save();
    if(state.owned.length===realms.length){notify('Conquest Complete');return;}
    notify('Realm Conquered');
  });

import struct,zlib

def read_png(p):
    data=open(p,'rb').read();pos=8;chunks=[]
    while pos<len(data):
        ln=struct.unpack('>I',data[pos:pos+4])[0];typ=data[pos+4:pos+8];chunk=data[pos+8:pos+8+ln];pos+=12+ln
        chunks.append((typ,chunk))
    w,h,bd,ct,_,_,_=struct.unpack('>IIBBBBB',next(c for t,c in chunks if t==b'IHDR'))
    raw=zlib.decompress(b''.join(c for t,c in chunks if t==b'IDAT'))
    bpp={2:3,6:4}[ct];stride=w*bpp;rows=[];prev=bytearray(stride);i=0
    for y in range(h):
        f=raw[i];i+=1;line=bytearray(raw[i:i+stride]);i+=stride
        if f==1:
            for x in range(bpp,stride): line[x]=(line[x]+line[x-bpp])&255
        elif f==2:
            for x in range(stride): line[x]=(line[x]+prev[x])&255
        elif f==3:
            for x in range(stride): line[x]=(line[x]+((line[x-bpp] if x>=bpp else 0)+prev[x])//2)&255
        elif f==4:
            for x in range(stride):
                a=line[x-bpp] if x>=bpp else 0;b=prev[x];c=prev[x-bpp] if x>=bpp else 0
                pp=a+b-c;pa=abs(pp-a);pb=abs(pp-b);pc=abs(pp-c)
                pr=a if pa<=pb and pa<=pc else (b if pb<=pc else c)
                line[x]=(line[x]+pr)&255
        rows.append(line);prev=line
    return w,h,bpp,rows

def write_png(p,w,h,rows):
    raw=b''.join(b'\x00'+bytes(r) for r in rows)
    def chunk(t,d): return struct.pack('>I',len(d))+t+d+struct.pack('>I',zlib.crc32(t+d)&0xffffffff)
    out=b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n'+chunk(b'IHDR',struct.pack('>IIBBBBB',w,h,8,2,0,0,0))+chunk(b'IDAT',zlib.compress(raw,6))+chunk(b'IEND',b'')
    open(p,'wb').write(out)
